items.title: Ciena's Backlog Or Arista's Margins: Which Should Carry Your AI Network Bet?
items.summary: If you own Ciena (CIEN) or Arista Networks, you own one idea: AI is driving fast growth in network traffic, and both sell the equipment that carries it. Both raised their revenue outlooks in their latest reports, and both say they could ship more if supply loosened. Then the pair splits. Ciena's case rests on orders it cannot yet fill, while Arista already keeps about 43 cents of every sales dollar as operating profit.
